/bin/zsh -lc 'cat tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py; git rev-parse HEAD; python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
for page in Path('.').rglob('*.md'):
    for target in re.findall(r'\\[["'^'"\\]]*\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        path = target.split('#', 1)[0]
        if path and not (page.parent / path).exists():
            raise SystemExit(f'Broken link: {page}: {target}')
assert not Path('docs/work/investigation/repeated-completion.md').exists()
for page in Path('.').rglob('*.md'):
    assert 'work/investigation/repeated-completion.md' not in page.read_text(), page
print('Documentation links resolve; completed investigation record and incoming links removed.')
PY
 git status --short"
